definitions.explanation: A government official who handles administrative and clerical duties, as opposed to technical or specialized officers. A formal title used in Japan's civil service system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧{事務官|じむかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a court clerk.

examples.japanese: {事務官|じむかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}{試験|しけん}→採用試験：29861_saiyoushiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧。
examples.english: I passed the administrative officer recruitment exam.

examples.japanese: ⟦{外務省|がいむしょう}→外務省：31654_gaimushou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{事務官|じむかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧な⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{携|たずさ}わる→携わる：09333_tazusawaru⟧。
examples.english: Administrative officials at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs are also involved in international affairs.

notes:
In the Japanese civil service {事務官|じむかん} (administrative officer) is contrasted with {技官|ぎかん} (technical officer).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧{事務官|じむかん}: court clerk
- ⟦{検察|けんさつ}→検察：11086_kensatsu⟧{事務官|じむかん}: prosecution clerk
- ⟦{外務|がいむ}→外務：24160_gaimu⟧{事務官|じむかん}: foreign-ministry administrative officer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事務員|じむいん}→事務員：25266_jimuin⟧: office clerk; mostly in private companies
- ⟦{官僚|かんりょう}→官僚：02780_kanryou⟧: bureaucrat; a senior government official
